title: Pneumonia susceptibility predicted effector genes (Reay WR et al. 2022)
bodyHtml:
This table displays results from the study:

The genetic architecture of pneumonia susceptibility implicates mucin biology and a relationship with psychiatric illness.
Reay WR, et al.
Nat Commun. 2022 Jun 29;13(1):3756. doi: 10.1038/s41467-022-31473-3.
PMID: 35768473

The authors performed a genome-wide meta-analysis of lifetime pneumonia susceptibility in 74,323 cases and 316,721 controls, and then integrated multiple evidence types to predict likely effector genes. Mouse over the column headers for details about each evidence type.
